The necklace features intricate silver-tone metalwork with mesh-like or filigree textures, interspersed with clusters of pink and clear faceted beads or crystals. A small, loose oval ring lies separately below the main piece. In the top left corner, a portion of eyeglasses is visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a faint, ghostly outline of an oval ring floating on the background surface. It appears semi-transparent and disconnected from any physical source, suggesting a generation artifact or a reflection that doesn't match the lighting physics of the main object.
